$comment: Mobile Lighthouse CI gate. Companion to lighthouserc.json (desktop); CI gates on BOTH form factors. Omitting the desktop preset makes Lighthouse apply its default mobile profile (Moto G4, 4x CPU + slow-4G simulated throttling), which is far harsher than desktop. The demo nonetheless measures mobile Performance 0.98-1.00 and Accessibility 0.96-1.00, so the floors here are held IDENTICAL to the desktop gate (perf>=0.90, a11y>=0.95, BP>=0.95, SEO>=0.90) — strict, with ~8 points of headroom for single-run variance and the tracked /adr theme-init flash (#279). Do NOT loosen these to make a heavier demo pass; fix the demo (ADR-039).
